messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: multiple serve-runtime pods in us-west-2 failing with Evicted / OOM due to ephemeral-storage pressure (node-rt-12). Threshold exceeded at 14:02 UTC. Paging oncall.
Jorge (eng-oncall): acknowledged, I'm on it. Patch window? any customer-facing impact reported yet?
Lina (Customer Success): seeing elevated error rates from several customers (org: acme, beta-shop) hitting text-gen endpoints; retries spiking. Customers reporting timeouts ~500ms->5s and some failures.
Priya (eng-runtime): logs look like massive modelcache + runtime logs grew quickly. Suspect debug log flood from a recent config flip. Can someone grab pod logs and df -h on the node?
Sasha (eng-sre): on the node now. /var/lib/modelcache is at 98% used, /tmp at 96%. Kube eviction reason: "eviction - nodefs". Also seeing many small rotated logs not being pruned.
Jorge (eng-oncall): runbook step 1: identify offending pods. Priya, can you list pods and PVC usage for that node?
Priya (eng-runtime): running:
```
kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-rt-12
# output (truncated):
redwood/serve-abcdef-0   Running   2/2   50%   node-rt-12
redwood/modelcache-1     Running   1/1   99%   node-rt-12
redwood/logcollector-0   CrashLoop 0/1   95%   node-rt-12
```
and
```
kubectl exec -n redwood modelcache-1 -- df -h /var/lib/modelcache /tmp
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme1n1p1  200G 198G  1.0G  99% /var/lib/modelcache
tmpfs            32G   31G  1.0G  96% /tmp
```
Priya (eng-runtime): also tail of modelcache.log shows repeated cache writes and a flood of "DEBUG store_chunk" from a single internal shard after the latest deploy.
Jorge (eng-oncall): ops-runbook-bot, show runbook for disk-pressure-eviction.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: disk-pressure-eviction -> Steps: 1) throttle/scale offending pods 2) delete temp debug logs 3) cordon node if necessary 4) migrate pods
Sasha (eng-sre): cordoning node to prevent more scheduling: `kubectl cordon node-rt-12` done. No new pods will land.
Jorge (eng-oncall): immediate mitigation: scale modelcache replicas down to 0 on that node and restart logcollector to stop accumulation. Priya, can you patch deployment to reduce log level and scale down the writer?
Priya (eng-runtime): applying hotfix: setting REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info and scaling modelcache to 1 replica cluster-wide while we clear disk on node-rt-12.
```
kubectl set env deployment/logcollector REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info -n redwood
kubectl scale deployment modelcache --replicas=1 -n redwood
```
Priya (eng-runtime): also running cleanup script to rotate and compress old logs on node:
```
ssh node-rt-12 'sudo find /var/log/redwood -type f -mtime +1 -exec gzip {} \; ; sudo rm -f /var/log/redwood/*.old'
```
Sasha (eng-sre): freeing space: purged 120GB from /var/lib/modelcache by removing stale shards flagged >30d. Current usage: 58GB free.
Priya (eng-runtime): restarting modelcache pod on that node to drop caches and reclaim tmpfs:
```
kubectl delete pod modelcache-1 -n redwood --grace-period=10
```
Jorge (eng-oncall): monitoring metrics. Lina, please update customers on temporary degraded performance while we mitigate.
Lina (Customer Success): posting note to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated error rates and timeouts; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with timeline and whether a rollback is needed." :eyes:
incident-bot: Pager: oncall escalation to Sasha (eng-sre) at 14:12 UTC due to increasing evictions.
Sasha (eng-sre): taking over incident lead. Observability: CPU/IO not saturated, this is pure filesystem fill from logs + model shards. Plan: ensure loglevel revert, run cache GC, and migrate critical serving pods to healthy nodes.
Priya (eng-runtime): live migration: `kubectl drain node-rt-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` (will evict pods). Doing it in waves to avoid mass restarts.
Sasha (eng-sre): initiating drain with `--grace-period=60`. Migrating 6 critical pods first.
Jorge (eng-oncall): reminder: enable fallback routing to regional spare capacity (us-west-1) for higher tier customers. Triggering routing override now.
Priya (eng-runtime): routing override in control plane: set route-policy serve->fallback-region for tier:enterprise : DONE
Lina (Customer Success): customers on enterprise tier seeing fewer errors now. Public metrics show error rate dropping from 8% -> 1.2% over the last 6m.
Sasha (eng-sre): node drained successfully. There were two pods that failed termination due to crashloop; we forced delete and they rescheduled elsewhere.
Priya (eng-runtime): restarted the serving runtime after eviction: startup logs show one GPU init warn but no CUDA OOM. Serving latencies back to normal median ~120ms.
Jorge (eng-oncall): root cause hypothesis: a recent config flip enabled DEBUG logging for the modelcache writer shard and an upstream job started writing full model shards into /var/lib/modelcache without eviction GC. Combined with log retention, node ran out of ephemeral storage causing kube eviction.
Sasha (eng-sre): post-mitigation checklist: 1) validate disk pressure gone 2) revert debug flip in config repo 3) add alert for sudden inode/dir growth 4) enable automatic log rotation TTL 5) create k8s pod anti-affinity to avoid packing caches onto single node
ops-runbook-bot: Checklist entry created: INC-1768004321-disk-evict -> assigned to Sasha, Priya, Jorge
Jorge (eng-oncall): I'll prepare a short incident summary and customer impact note. Next: schedule a follow-up postmortem with root cause and action items. Oncall handoff to night team at 23:00 UTC, Sasha will remain owner until handoff.
Lina (Customer Success): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and share the status page update.
Priya (eng-runtime): one last note: added a hotpatch to the runtime to limit per-shard write throughput while we implement proper GC. patch id: hg-rt-2026-03. Monitoring disk writes now.
Sasha (eng-sre): closing live incident channel for now, we'll keep this thread open for the handoff and postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
